• Origin: Cultivar
  • Growth rate: Slow
  • Height: 0–5+ cm
  • Light demand: Medium
  • CO2: Low

Achieving the right balance of light is crucial: good lighting enhances the white patterns, but excessive light can lead to damage and algae issues. With slow growth, Anubias 'Pinto' demands patience. It can be incorporated into aquascapes by attaching it to rocks or wood in the aquarium. Never cover the rhizome, as this can result in rotting and the death of the plant.

Anubias 'Pinto' is a selected cultivar of Anubias barteri. Its leaves, measuring 3–6 cm, show patterns of white, light green and dark green. These patterns can vary depending on the environment, and under certain conditions the plant may develop entirely dark green leaves.
